concerns.text: FR-002 defers the split ratios ('[deferred] train, [deferred] validation, [deferred] test'), but the project constitution Principle VI mandates a fixed scaffold-based split of 80% train, 10% validation, 10% test. The spec should state these ratios rather than deferring a value the constitution has already fixed; as written, FR-002 is compatible with a split that violates Principle VI.

SC-003 says memory usage is measured against the 7 GB RAM limit 'to verify the model size constraint is respected', conflating the ≤5M-parameter constraint (FR-003) with the RAM limit. These are two distinct constraints; the wording should separate them or reference the correct one.
